svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.title: NUT layers and interfaces
svg.desc: Four layers, top to bottom. Clients (upsmon shuts down its own host; upsc and upslog read and log; upsrw and upscmd make permitted changes and commands; NUT-Monitor, Nagios, Zenoss and other integrations) use the NUT network protocol over TCP, remotely or via localhost, to reach upsd. upsd keeps an in-memory cache of driver data. On the same server host, upsd talks to each driver with the NUT socket protocol over Unix domain sockets or Windows named pipes. Each driver keeps its own variables and auxiliary data. Drivers by device link: serial (bcmxcp, apcsmart, genericups, mge-shut) and USB (usbhid-ups) are point to point; network (snmp-ups for SNMP, netxml-ups for XML/HTTP); local IPMI through /dev/ipmi0 (nut-ipmipsu); and other drivers. Devices include UPSes, PDUs, solar controllers (SCD), server PSUs and other power devices; a device may offer several links. Power wiring is not shown.
